_readme: Per-unit translation policy for en/. Keys: '<file>' (whole page) or '<file>#<section id>'. Values: translate (default) | localize (adapt Taiwan-specific content for a global reader; must add a 'Note:' callout) | transcreate (rewrite for the audience; sales.html) | rewrite (prompts that assume Chinese output) | skip (excluded; card shows 'Chinese only'). Anything not listed = translate.

ch1_intro.html#why.brief: 「這套 WoowTech Headscale」→ describe as the Headscale add-on / this setup; drop Taiwan-only framing.

ch2_install.html#steps.brief: Add-on store path via the WoowTech repository URL; keep the URL verbatim.

ch9_dns.html#steps.brief: Chinese hostname examples → living-room / nas style examples.

sales.html.brief: Overseas version: no TWD, no Taiwan-only IP policy, real contact channel; Option A (self-hosted) / Option B (managed by WoowTech). Awaiting business brief from Elmo.

prompts.html.brief: Prompts must instruct the AI to answer in English; keep CLI/API strings verbatim; fix the stated count (23 prompts).

skills.html.brief: Full translation per 2026-08-31 decision; any prompt demanding Traditional Chinese output becomes English-only.
